d: As an Account Management Executive, you will be the primary owner of a diverse portfolio of clients, with a focus on high-growth accounts within the Tabby ecosystem. Unlike the intern level, you are expected to move beyond support and proactively drive the strategic direction of your accounts. You will be responsible for maximizing merchant lifetime value through expert cross-selling, upselling, and the integration of new Tabby features. You will act as a consultant to our partners, ensuring Tabby is deeply embedded in their growth strategy while leading cross-functional projects that optimize our internal operations and product delivery
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
Experience: 1–3 years of proven experience in Account Management, Sales, or Client Success (preferably in Tech or FinTech).
Analytical Rigor: A strong ability to interpret data and translate it into a commercial narrative. You should be comfortable working with large datasets.
Agility: Proven ability to manage a high-volume portfolio while simultaneously leading internal projects with minimal supervision.
Tech Savvy: High proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce/HubSpot) and data visualization tools (Tableau/Looker).
Direct experience in the E-commerce, Payments, or FinTech industry in the MENA region.
A documented track record of meeting or exceeding Sales/Retention KPIs.
Experience in project management or process automation.
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and complex formulas).
r: li

Portfolio Growth & Strategy: Lead the strategic planning for high-potential accounts. Perform deep-dive segmentations to identify revenue gaps and execute aggressive growth plans through upselling and cross-selling tailored financial solutions.
li

Relationship Leadership: Build and nurture high-level relationships with key decision-makers (C-level, Heads of E-commerce, etc.). Serve as a trusted advisor who understands their business health and aligns Tabby’s roadmap with their commercial goals.
li

Project Leadership: Spearhead strategic initiatives across product, tech, and marketing teams. You won't just contribute; you will own the execution of product launches and operational enhancements that improve the merchant experience across the board.
li

Advanced Analytics & Consulting: Master the use of data to tell a story. You will produce and present high-level business reviews, utilizing complex data sets to provide merchants with actionable insights. You are expected to build and maintain your own dashboards to track KPIs and identify churn risks before they happen.
li

Strategic Problem Solving: Take full ownership of complex account issues. Coordinate across tech and operations to resolve systemic problems, ensuring long-term structural fixes rather than just "band-aid" solutions.
li
Commercial Negotiation: Lead negotiations for contract renewals, fee structures, and promotional participation, ensuring a win-win outcome that secures Tabby’s revenue and the merchant’s loyalty.
li
Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management.
x: We have an inclusive company culture, embracing diversity, integrity and transparency. We strive for work-life balance and cherish the moments you spend with your loved ones, off-work. In the same spirit as for our product, we are caring and nurturing for our employees.

Our people are granted 100% trust and freedom to apply their own vision and come up with their ideas from day 1 at Tabby. You are the one who takes responsibility for your area of work. We encourage everyone to think and make decisions like Tabby was their own business, well because it is. Our employee stock options programme is available for everyone.
You will have an opportunity to learn and grow in one of the fastest growing fintech companies in the region
We offer you relocation support as well as we guide you through all the process.
We’ll set you up with the devices required for your work.

d: Job Title: Account and Sales Manager - Drilling Waste Management & Fluids

Our client is looking for sales and account manager to manage key accounts and drive sales growth for drilling waste management and drilling fluid solutions in Oman's oil & gas sector. Build relationships with operators, drilling contractors, and EPCs to increase market penetration.
q: 1+ years of experience in sales/account management in O&G drilling sector
2+ years in technical sales within Oil & Gas Drilling Waste Management (DWM) and/or Drilling Fluids (DF).
Strong relationships with O&G operators/contractors in Oman
Fluent in English; Arabic a plus
r: li
Manage existing client relationships and prospect new business in Oman's drilling sector
li
Develop sales strategies for drilling waste disposal and drilling fluid services
li
Prepare proposals, negotiate contracts, and close deals
li
Coordinate with operations to ensure client requirements are met
li
Report sales performance and market trends to management
